item.title: Crocs and Disney Just Dropped the Most Unexpected Park Accessory of 2026
item.description: Crocs has unexpectedly expanded its Disney collaboration with a customizable Mickey and Friends headband that allows you to add up to 12 Jibbitz charms. It’s designed to prevent hair damage and can be styled to match your mood. Available in four colors for Minnie and two for Mickey, it’s marketed as a practical alternative to traditional Disney ears for all-day wear. Reactions among Disney fans are mixed, with some seeing it as genius and others as unhinged.
